CONTACTS_FILTER.TITLE: Filter Contacts
CONTACTS_FILTER.SUBTITLE: Add filters below and hit 'Submit' to filter contacts.
CONTACTS_FILTER.CUSTOM_VIEWS_SUBTITLE: Add or remove filters and update your segment.
CONTACTS_FILTER.FILTER_DELETE_ERROR: You should have atleast one filter to save

AUDIENCE.CONVERSATION_NOTE: Conversation conditions match contacts with at least one such conversation (Equal to) or none (Not equal to), among the conversations you can see.
AUDIENCE.COMMERCE_NOTE: Commerce conditions use the latest orders {installationName} has read for each linked store, so figures are visible orders and spend, not lifetime totals. Spend is per currency.
AUDIENCE.UNREAD: Orders haven’t been read yet for {count} linked contacts, so order conditions can’t match them. They’re read when an agent opens the contact’s conversation or the store sends an update.

SHARED.READ_ONLY: This is a shared audience. Only administrators can change it; you can still adjust the filters and apply them.
SHARED.EDIT: Shared audience: everyone in the account can open it, and automation rules can use it.
SHARED.USED_BY: This shared audience is used by {rules} active automation rules and {campaigns} campaigns not yet sent. Saving changes what they match at once.

EXPLAINER.TITLE: What a shared audience is
EXPLAINER.BODY: A live customer group. You save the rule once and the product works out who matches it every time the audience is used, so the group keeps up with your customers on its own.

VS_LABEL.TITLE: Label or shared audience?
VS_LABEL.LABEL: A label is a sticker you put on the customers you choose. It stays until someone takes it off.
VS_LABEL.AUDIENCE: A shared audience is a saved question about your customers, answered again every time it is used.
VS_LABEL.RULE: If you can point at the customers, use a label. If you can describe them, use an audience.
